name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. Initially a promising law graduate, he found himself drawn to the structured chaos and high-stakes environment of Formula racing after volunteering at a local event. He quickly recognized the need for strong HR practices within teams, seeing firsthand how talent management could directly impact performance on the track.

Wei's approach to HR is data-driven and fiercely focused on creating an environment of excellence. He believes in rigorous talent identification and development, ensuring that every team member is positioned for success. His demanding nature stems from a desire to push individuals to reach their full potential, fostering a high-performance culture within the Sprint V8 Team. He is particularly adept at resolving conflicts and ensuring fair treatment, while remaining ruthlessly efficient.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a side part
physical.description: Li Wei has a slender build and a focused expression, often accentuated by his frameless glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Insists on using a standing desk, even during long meetings.
Has a collection of miniature race cars displayed on his desk.
